Game Overview

Sprunki Build Tower is a puzzle title where stack and balance Sprunki in this delightful physics puzzle. Strategize to keep these unique creatures from toppling as you build towering structures through 26 increasingly challenging levels. Precision and timing are key to mastering the art of Sprunki placement. Can you keep them all on screen?
